code.description: The authorization code received from the authorization server.

code_verifier.description: PKCE parameters (if the client used PKCE during the authorization request)

code_challenge.description: PKCE parameters (RFC 7636) for public clients and enhanced security

oneOf.description:
The method used to derive the code challenge (e.g., "S256" or "plain").
only required if `code_challenge` is present. "S256" is strongly recommended in OAuth 2.1 for better security.

redirect_uri.description: redirect URI is optional if the client has only one registered redirect URI

resource.description: Audience parameter (RFC 8707) to specify the intended recipients of the token.

authorization_endpoint.description:
URL of the authorization endpoint.
REQUIRED unless no grant types use it.

code_challenge_methods_supported.description: PKCE code challenge methods supported (S256 is strongly recommended in 2.1).

grant_types_supported.description:
List of supported grant types.
In OAuth 2.1: authorization_code, client_credentials, refresh_token (no implicit/password).

introspection_endpoint.description: URL of the token introspection endpoint (RFC 7662).

introspection_endpoint_auth_methods_supp.description: Client authentication methods supported by the introspection endpoint.

introspection_endpoint_auth_signing_alg_.description: JWS signing algorithms supported for JWT auth at the introspection endpoint.

issuer.description:
REQUIRED. The authorization server's issuer identifier.
URL using https scheme with no query or fragment.

jwks_uri.description: URL of the JWK Set document containing the server's public keys.

op_policy_uri.description: URL for the authorization server's policy on client use of data.

op_tos_uri.description: URL for the authorization server's terms of service.

pushed_authorization_request_endpoint.description: List of supported revocation endpoint authentication signing algorithms (additional).

registration_endpoint.description: URL of the Dynamic Client Registration endpoint.

require_pkce.description: Whether the server requires PKCE for all clients (OAuth 2.1 best practice).

response_modes_supported.description:
List of supported response_mode values.
Defaults to ["query", "fragment"] if omitted.

response_types_supported.description:
REQUIRED. List of supported response_type values.
In OAuth 2.1 this should primarily be ["code"].

revocation_endpoint.description: URL of the token revocation endpoint (RFC 7009).

revocation_endpoint_auth_methods_support.description: Client authentication methods supported by the revocation endpoint.

revocation_endpoint_auth_signing_alg_val.description: JWS signing algorithms supported for JWT auth at the revocation endpoint.

scopes_supported.description: RECOMMENDED. List of supported OAuth 2.0 scope values.

token_endpoint.description:
URL of the token endpoint.
REQUIRED in most cases (especially for OAuth 2.1).

token_endpoint_auth_methods_supported.description: List of client authentication methods supported by the token endpoint.

token_endpoint_auth_signing_alg_values_s.description:
JWS signing algorithms supported for JWT client authentication
at the token endpoint (private_key_jwt, client_secret_jwt).

ui_locales_supported.description: Languages and scripts supported for the user interface (BCP 47).

application.description: Unique identifier for the application (assigned by the authorization server).

client_id.description: Unique identifier for the client application (assigned by the authorization server).

client_id_issued_at.description: Time at which the client identifier was issued (Unix timestamp).

client_name.description: Human-readable name of the client application.

client_secret.description: Optional or required depending on registration type (Public vs Confidential).

client_secret_expires_at.description: Time at which the client secret will expire (0 or None for no expiration).

client_uri.description: URL of the home page of the client.

contacts.description: Array of email addresses for people responsible for this client.

logo_uri.description: URL that references a logo for the client application.

policy_uri.description: URL for the application's privacy policy.

software_id.description: A unique identifier string assigned by the software issuer.

software_statement.description: A digitally signed JWT assertion containing verifiable client metadata.

software_version.description: A version identifier string string assigned by the software issuer.

token_endpoint_auth_method.description:
Requested authentication method for the token endpoint
(e.g., `client_secret_basic`, `client_secret_post`, `private_key_jwt`).

tos_uri.description: URL for the application's terms of service.

CodeChallengeMethod.description:
PKCE code challenge methods (RFC 7636).
the `plain` method is not included as it is not recommended in OAuth 2.1 due to security weaknesses. Only `S256` is supported for better security.

ErrorResponse.description:
Standard OAuth 2.0 error response structure (RFC 6749 Section 5.2).
should match fields from crates/model/src/contract/error_response.rs

ResponseType.description:
Valid OAuth 2.0 response types for the authorization endpoint.
we do not support the `token` or `id_token` response type (implicit flow) as it is not recommended in OAuth 2.1 and has security weaknesses.

TokenEndpointAuthMethod.description: Client token endpoint authentication methods (RFC 7591 / OIDC).

authorization_details.description: JSON-encoded authorization details array in the OAuth form field.

access_token.description: The access token issued by the authorization server.

expires_in.description: The lifetime in seconds of the id/access token.

iss.description: The identifier of the authorization server that issued the token.

oneOf.description: The refresh token, which can be used to obtain new access tokens using the same authorization grant.

refresh_token_expires_in.description: The lifetime in seconds of the refresh token.

scope.description: The scope of the access token as described by the authorization server.

token_type.description: The type of the token issued.

setup_authorization.description: Send the complete value Setup <code> over verified HTTPS, not an OAuth Bearer token. Retrieve the host-generated code only through protected host/deployment management. Keep it transient; never put it in URLs, logs, cookies or browser storage. Required for every Join/retry and before completion for every Create/retry, admission check, retained intent lookup and cancel. Retired after verified completion. The header-free Create alternative is only an exact completed retry authenticated using the request's administrator/password, not unauthenticated setup.
setup_authorization.name: Authorization

setup_code.description: Setup <this owner's host-generated code>; never OAuth or another owner's code
setup_code.name: Authorization

200.description: Revoked all client signing keys and local private material

403.description: Current owner permission or approval denied

post.description: Requires verified exact independent approval and current owner permission. Returns a capability only through the operation-bound recipient callback.

get.description: WebSocket upgrade only. The subsequent bounded binary SQL history protocol is not implemented by generated HTTP clients.

101.description: Switching to bounded history WebSocket protocol

204.description: This owner code is currently admitted

202.description: Exact Create accepted; empty body, not completion

post.description: Worker handoff over verified HTTPS. Requires an active exact Setup operation and operation-bound recipient challenge; discovery grants no authority. Never log capability or registration credentials.
Worker-only return channel: active exact admitted Join, matching approval and constant-time return nonce, and a 64-character capability are required. Not OAuth authority.

200.description: Operation-bound public owner metadata, not setup authorization

409.description: Public owner metadata not yet available

post.description: Worker handoff over verified HTTPS. Requires an active exact Setup operation and operation-bound recipient challenge; discovery grants no authority. Never log capability or registration credentials.

200.description: Exact retained nonsecret operation with authenticated issuer

202.description: Exact Join accepted after authenticated discovery; empty body

400.description: Invalid tuple; Join forbids password and administrator

200.description: Owner-local state; no login Client or secret

503.description: Admission unavailable (empty body), or current owner readiness failed (nonsecret status with ready:false)

parameters.description: PKCE parameters (RFC 7636) for public clients and enhanced security

403.description: Caller is not permitted to validate tokens

parameters.description: Optional HTTP Basic OAuth Client credentials; client_credentials also accepts client_secret_post
parameters.name: Authorization

post.description: Check the host-local setup capability only. A successful check neither binds intent nor authorizes a later request; send Authorization on every setup mutation.

204.description: Setup capability currently valid; no body

401.description: Missing, invalid or retired setup capability

post.description: Requires the setup capability and exact active nonsecret Create or Join intent (including discovered Join issuer, recoverable through /idp/setup/intent). Cancellation and entry into retirement serialize on the same active-operation lock: cancellation cannot acknowledge 204 after retirement starts (409 while the capability remains valid; retired capabilities deny). A 204 is not proof cleanup has finished; observe status. Disconnect alone never cancels accepted work.

204.description: Exact active cancellation token signaled; no body; cleanup may still be running

400.description: Invalid intent (empty body), or malformed/unreadable JSON (text/plain rejection)

401.description: Missing, invalid or retired setup capability

409.description: No active cancellable work, mismatching intent or retirement already started

422.description: JSON does not match a Create or Join intent

post.description: Before completion, Authorization: Setup <code> is required for every request, including exact retries. Durable exact intent binding precedes 202 and owner mutation. Acceptance is not completion: poll /idp/setup/status. Request disconnect does not cancel host-owned work; use explicit cancel. After completion, only an exact retained retry authenticated through the normal password grant using the supplied administrator/password can return 200; no setup header or Bearer token is required for that retry.

200.description: Exact completed retry authenticated with normal password grant; ready:true

202.description: Durably admitted or already active exact Create; ready:false; observe completion through setup status

400.description: Invalid human intent/password (empty body), or malformed/unreadable JSON (text/plain rejection)

401.description: Setup capability or normal completed authentication denied

409.description: Conflicting retained/active intent, occupied command queue or cancellation before acceptance

503.description: Admission, coordinator or completed readiness/authentication unavailable; no body. Accepted provisioning failures are observed through status, not this response

post.description: Read the exact retained nonsecret unified Create or Join intent using the current setup capability. Join includes the authenticated peer and discovered issuer. No request body; does not resume mutation or authorize another request. Retired capabilities deny.

200.description: Validated canonical retained intent for this host's owner scope

401.description: Missing, invalid or retired setup capability

503.description: Protected state unavailable or retained intent invalid; no body

post.description: Requires Authorization: Setup <code> on every request. Authenticates issuer discovery against the pinned peer before durable canonical Join admission and 202. No issuer or credentials are accepted from the caller. Accepted work belongs to the host, not the HTTP request; poll status and use authorized exact cancellation. Exact retries retain peer/issuer and identity, including complete-owner/unretired-admission finalization. Retired admission denies; normal User authorization remains separate on source approval routes.

202.description: Durably admitted or already active exact Join; joining is not readiness

400.description: Invalid nonce, Node name or canonical pinned peer

401.description: Missing, invalid or retired setup capability

503.description: Discovery, admission or coordinator unavailable; accepted owner failures appear in status

get.description: Public nonsecret setup observation, not mutation authority. Poll after 202. Completed status re-evaluates existing local owner readiness on every request; learned revocation or a failed check returns 503 with ready:false and no login Client. Normal protected APIs retain their independent authentication/authorization. No password, token or setup code is returned.

200.description: Current setup state; awaiting_choice, creating, joining and unfinished are not completion
